nodes.question: How are recycled synthetic fibres beneficial to the environment?
nodes.answer: Recycled synthetic fibres reduce the use of virgin materials, energy, and chemical consumption, thus helping in conservation efforts and reducing the dependency on freshly derived raw materials.
